features: 10000mAh High Capacity- Equipped with a 10000mAh Li-Polymer battery to provide reliable backup power for smartphones, tablets and other USB-powered devices during travel and daily use.
22.5W Fast Charging- Supports up to 22.5W fast charging output through USB and Type-C ports for quicker and more efficient charging performance.
Dual Output Ports- Features USB and Type-C output ports for convenient charging compatibility with multiple modern devices.
Compact & Portable Design- Slim and lightweight design makes it easy to carry in bags, backpacks and pockets for travel, office and outdoor use.
Safe & Reliable Charging- Built with advanced safety protection against overcharging, overvoltage and short circuits for secure everyday charging.
description: The EVM EnBolt 10000mAh Power Bank EVM P0208 is designed to deliver reliable portable power with fast charging support for modern devices. Featuring a high-capacity 10000mAh Li-Polymer battery and up to 22.5W fast charging output, this power bank ensures efficient charging for smartphones, tablets and USB-powered devices.Equipped with both USB and Type-C output ports, the EnBolt power bank offers versatile charging compatibility while supporting fast and stable power delivery. Its compact and lightweight design makes it ideal for travel, office use, commuting and everyday backup power needs.The power bank also includes multiple safety protections against overvoltage, overcharging and short circuits, ensuring safe and dependable performance during daily usage. With premium build quality and portable convenience, the EVM EnBolt is an ideal charging companion for users on the go.
